•	Diploma in Agriculture or higher equivalent

Position Summary:

On behalf of our client, Global Skilled Employment Services, is looking for a skilled and experienced Animal Husbandry Technician who have strong communication skills, self-motivated and must have the ability to work independently and as a member of a team.

Major duties includes: 
•	Artificially inseminate livestock for breeding purposes
•	Use understanding of animal anatomy to watch for optimum insemination conditions
•	Provide advice on breeding selection and techniques
•	Maintaining and evaluating records of all insemination history
•	Clean all equipment to ensure sanitary breeding practices
•	Vaccinate animals when needed
•	Handle animals humanely
•	Store semen to perform the insemination
•	Follow proper safety protocols when handling hazardous materials, such as liquid nitrogen
•	Physically observe and inspect all animals and identify harmful pathogenic micro-organisms, insects, parasites, or fungal infection and perform the proper treatment and controlling methods,
•	When working with livestock, adhere to Animal Welfare and Qualify Codes.
•	Observation for the wellbeing of animals
•	Organizing the movement of the animals for breeding purposes
•	Report regularly and punctually to the operations manager on the breeding activity of the farm
•	Work effectively as a member of a team to achieve pre-determined team goals.
•	Attend and participate in site and section head meetings, which may be arranged from time to time by the operations manager.
•	Ensure that the company’s obligations under the current legislation are observed and that quality training and work activities are conducted in a safe and responsible manner.
•	Maintain the Farm facilities and associated equipment in a clean and tidy condition.
•	Observe all requirements for confidentiality of company information and the privacy requirements of individuals as enacted by legislation such as the Privacy Act.
•	Observe all company biosecurity requirements
•	Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, statutes and government guidelines.
•	Promote the good standing of the company in the local and wider community by the adoption of a professional, sympathetic and co-operative approach when dealing with others.
•	Undertake any other duties or specific tasks that may be nominated by the assistant or operations manager from time to time.

This is a full-time position which may involve weekend work and some unplanned hours of work where the need arises.

Other required skills:
•	Good written and verbal communication skills;
•	Advance knowledge in animal husbandry, animal welfare and legislation, dairy production, and OH&S;
•	Knowledge in computer programs/software is an advantage.


Qualified applicants may apply online.

Position: Chef 
Type: Full-time 
Employer: Heritage Sphere Pty Ltd T/A Imperial Indian Restaurant 
Location: Rockingham WA 6168 
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business
Heritage Sphere Pty Ltd T/A Imperial Indian Restaurant is a distinguished dining venue located at the Rockingham Foreshore, specialising in authentic Indian cuisine. Renowned for its vibrant ambiance and commitment to quality, the restaurant offers a wide array of traditional dishes including Butter Chicken, Garlic Naan, Prawn Madras, Malai Kofta, Dal Makhni, and Goat Curry, with many gluten-free options available. It prides itself on using fresh ingredients, exceptional service, and a welcoming environment that caters to both locals and tourists seeking a genuine taste of India. The business values culinary excellence, cultural heritage, and a supportive team culture where passion for food and hospitality drives a positive, collaborative workplace.
About the Position
The Chef plays a pivotal role in delivering high-quality Indian cuisine at Imperial Indian Restaurant. Reporting to management, this full-time position involves planning, organising, and overseeing the preparation and cooking of authentic dishes in a busy restaurant setting. The Chef ensures consistency in flavour, presentation, and food safety while contributing to menu development and kitchen efficiency, making them essential to maintaining the restaurant’s reputation for excellence and customer satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities
•	Planning menus, estimating food and labour costs, and ordering supplies to support efficient kitchen operations.
•	Preparing, seasoning, and cooking a variety of authentic Indian dishes, including curries, tandoori items, breads, and vegetarian options.
•	Monitoring the quality of dishes at all stages of preparation and presentation to uphold high standards.
•	Discussing food preparation issues with managers, kitchen staff, and waiting team to ensure smooth service.
•	Demonstrating cooking techniques and advising on procedures to support team development and consistency.
•	Maintaining cleanliness, hygiene, and food safety standards in line with regulatory requirements.
•	Managing kitchen inventory, minimising waste, and contributing to cost control measures.
Requirements
•	Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
•	Certificate III and IV in Kitchen Management, plus Diploma and Advanced Diploma in Hospitality Management.
•	Minimum 1 year of relevant experience.
•	Strong technical skills in Indian cuisine preparation, including mastery of spices, tandoor cooking, and regional dishes.
•	Excellent organisational and time-management abilities to handle a fast-paced kitchen environment.
•	Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
•	Commitment to food safety, hygiene, and quality standards.
How to Apply
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
